.TH "REGISTRY" "7" "March 2026" "NPM@10.9.7" ""
.SH "NAME"
\fBregistry\fR - The JavaScript Package Registry
.SS "Description"
.P
To resolve packages by name and version, npm talks to a registry website that implements the CommonJS Package Registry specification for reading package info.
.P
npm is configured to use the \fBnpm public registry\fR at \fI\(lahttps://registry.npmjs.org\(ra\fR by default. Use of the npm public registry is subject to terms of use available at \fI\(lahttps://docs.npmjs.c
